title: Time Jump: 3:00 — Restoration Phase Initiated

fields.narration: It is now 3:00. The forensic evidence is confirmed. The GCS-02 is isolated. The 915 MHz link is disconnected. The baseline image (GCS-03) is being loaded onto a spare GCS for re-verification. The team is now in the restoration phase. The aircraft remains in manual/attitude mode on the meadow. No further flights are authorized.
worldState: The forensic evidence from 09:12–09:15 has been validated and confirmed by the managed SOC.
GCS-02 is physically isolated: the 915 MHz radio has been disconnected, and no further commands are being sent.
The baseline image (03.2026-B) from HUOG-NAS01 has been deployed to GCS-03 for verification.
UAS-11 remains in manual/attitude mode on the meadow, with the battery at 78% and no further flight authorization.
The site is under full standdown. No new flights are permitted until baseline verification is complete.
The Incident Commander has activated the baseline verification process per HUOG-ISP Section 9.1.
fields.facilitatorNote: This time jump confirms the team has completed the forensic isolation phase and is now in the formal restoration phase. Watch for role-specific actions: the TL should initiate the GCS baseline re-verification, the IC should confirm the log update, and the ASO should confirm FSDO is informed of the new status.
